text:
Shoppers today buy food that has often travelled thousands of kilometres, and many of them have no idea where it was grown. I largely agree that food origin should be labelled on products, since labels help shoppers to make informed choices, although the rules should not be too costly.

To begin with, labels showing where food comes from help shoppers to make informed choices. Buyers can support local farmers, avoid products linked to poor safety records or very long transport, and decide whether they are willing to pay more for particular regions. If a problem such as contamination occurs, a clear origin also makes it easier to trace the source and withdraw the product quickly. A shopper who reads that apples were grown in a nearby region, for example, may choose them over apples flown from another continent, which reduces transport emissions.

Furthermore, labelling gives producers a reason to meet higher standards. When customers can see the origin, farmers and companies are more careful about quality and honesty, because their reputation is visible. It also protects consumers from misleading claims, such as a product described as local when only the packaging was done nearby. However, there are costs. Small producers may find complicated labelling expensive, and origin does not always indicate quality, since good and bad products exist in every country. Rules should therefore be simple and consistent, and phased in with support for small businesses. If the information is easy to read, more people will actually use it when they shop.

In conclusion, food origin should be labelled to a large extent, because it improves choice and accountability, provided that the rules are clear and affordable.

analysis.type_vi: Extent: nên ghi nguồn gốc thực phẩm trên sản phẩm đến mức nào — largely agree

plan.think: Mở bài bằng bối cảnh quen thuộc (thực phẩm đi hàng nghìn km, người mua không biết nguồn gốc) rồi largely agree + lý do + giới hạn (chi phí).

plan.step: 2. Lý do 1 — lựa chọn có thông tin
plan.think: Người mua ủng hộ nông dân địa phương, tránh sản phẩm có tiền sử an toàn kém hoặc vận chuyển quá xa; truy xuất nguồn gốc nhanh khi có sự cố. Ví dụ táo trồng gần so với táo vận chuyển bằng máy bay.

plan.step: 3. Lý do 2 — chuẩn mực cao hơn + giới hạn
plan.think: Danh tiếng hiển thị khiến người sản xuất cẩn thận hơn; chống tuyên bố gây hiểu lầm. Giới hạn: chi phí cho nhà sản xuất nhỏ; nguồn gốc không luôn thể hiện chất lượng; quy tắc đơn giản và áp dụng dần.
Ghi nguồn gốc ở mức độ lớn nếu quy định rõ ràng và chi phí hợp lý.
